answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 46421 Country: India Title: is gold plated items like ring ,watches etc. are allowed for men in islam? Question: Are gold plated items like ring, watches etc allowed for men in Islam? Answer ID: 46421 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1139/1084/N=9/1434) It is not lawful for men to wear any gold item on the occasion of marriage or elsewhere. It is haram as it is mentioned in Mishkat Shareef (p 378): عن علي أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أخذ حريرا فجعله في يمينه فأخذ ذهبا فجعله في شماله ثم قال : إن هذين حرام على ذكور أمتي رواه أحمد وأبوداؤد والنسائي . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
